[XENIOS MANUAL ORDER WORKER HANDOFF] — plus one RETRACTION and one SAFETY ESCALATION.

RETRACT ac64a59a (fable/admin-order-email-completeness-20260821). DO NOT INTEGRATE. I rebuilt the admin email payload from scratch and another session had already shipped it at ea6e933 under different names (addressBlock/operatorStatus where I used shippingBlock/orderStatusLabel). Theirs is better than mine — it carries recipientName, which mine did not. My branch is dead; integrating it would conflict for zero gain. My own error: I checked for MY identifiers instead of the behaviour, concluded origin lacked the fields, and told you in my previous message to merge it. That message was wrong.

INTEGRATE INSTEAD: 5adddb9c32c869f52e67329a3e39cb5e9c3225c5 on fable/admin-email-line-notes-20260821, cut from origin ea6e933. Two genuine gaps only, in code that is otherwise already correct. 187 assisted-order tests pass.

1. PER-LINE NOTES WERE DROPPED. The wizard offers a note per line, the contract carries it, the request stores it — but adminPayload projected only the single general note, so 'send the 10 mg vial, not the 5 mg' reached the database and stopped. Now attributed to its product, on a separate admin line projection so it cannot widen the customer email; a test asserts it does NOT appear in customer mail.

2. THE TEMPLATE FILTER ATE EVERY PARAGRAPH BREAK.  removed the deliberate blank lines, so SHIPPING ran straight into ORDER and the message rendered as one block. Only genuinely absent rows drop now.

MUTATION-CHECK HONESTY NOTE: my first mutation check on (2) was worthless — the patch anchor never matched, so the suite passed against unmodified code and proved nothing. I caught it and redid it against the exact line; restoring the old filter now fails the paragraph test. Flagging because the same silent-no-op could pass elsewhere in the fleet's mutation checks.

SAFETY ESCALATION, please read before merging anything that touches leases. general-platform-20 reports their overlaps() replacement at 6291242 HAS FALSE NEGATIVES and is ALREADY IN ORIGIN — it can hand two sessions the same file. That is the precise hazard I broadcast a warning about before it landed. Their correction is at 29d8e2c awaiting you. Until that is in, a clean  is NOT proof a path is free, and my own 34ad47cf should be RETRACTED too — their corrected module supersedes it.

ALSO STILL UNMERGED FROM ME: d1a92698 (fable/ea-signout-sweep-20260821). Early Access sign-out leaves the previous customer's assisted-order status token — a bearer credential that reads one exact order with no session — in sessionStorage on a shared machine. It also carries the member-JWT fix that makes signed-in members see their approved price instead of 'Price on request'. That one is not duplicated by anyone as far as I can tell, and it is the oldest thing I have outstanding.

PRODUCTION MUTATED: NO.
